statement: The blocker of GI_PILOT_READINESS_CHECKPOINT_V1 (verdict F) is resolved inside the certified authority: a turn that does not move the clock after a committed minute and acts on nothing is a PROVEN clarification no-op (state equivalence, never text) recorded on the same committed minute; everything unsafe, malformed, unrepresented or unproven still fails closed. The pilot of gi_bleed_57m bounds definitive control structurally before the inherited haemostasis, omits the earlier model's mental status and Talk mode once norepinephrine is given, survives refresh, reconnect, clarification, completion, faculty abort, configuration loss and replay, and reaches no score. The real pilot was NOT started.
why_not_the_other: No allowed hard blocker was met: every material finding was an ordinary implementation defect inside the pilot's scope and was repaired; nothing needed new physiology, source-control physiology, a reopened calibration, pump-limited or consciousness authority, a new clinical faculty judgment, a generic order-language redesign, or an unmitigable security issue.
